summary: CKD MVP end-to-end test. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases PASSED (auth, profile, campaigns, issues, notifications, leaderboard, flags, admin, media-upload auth). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): onboarding → login (admin 9999999999 + 123456) → home with featured campaign, announcements, campaign + issue list. All 5 bottom tabs (होम/अभियान/समस्या/सूचना/प्रोफ़ाइल) navigate. Admin panel renders dashboard stats (6 members, 4 campaigns, 1 open, 1 in-progress, 2 resolved issues). Leaderboard, Guidelines, Privacy static pages render in Hindi. New-user signup correctly routes to profile-setup. Cloudinary upload endpoint guarded by auth + content-type check (verified, actual upload not executed per instructions).

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Migrate any shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius usage (likely inside dependency components or inline styles) to boxShadow for RN Web compatibility.

Console warning: 'style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Auth login.tsx:64 and index.tsx:36 already pass resizeMode as prop, but a dependency or other Image usage may be passing it via style. Audit all <Image> usages.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Likely from a third-party RN component; main agent should audit and migrate.

action_items: (Low-priority) Address React Native deprecation warnings: replace shadow* with boxShadow, audit Image style.resizeMode usage, migrate props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents.

(Optional) Add a friendly inline error message on profile-setup when age_group is not selected, since the submit button silently no-ops; currently the form just doesn't navigate which can confuse users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 988 lines (>700 threshold) — consider splitting into routers (auth, campaigns, issues, admin, media) for maintainability.
verify_otp creates a brand-new user before checking is_banned; not a security issue (new users are not banned) but the flow could be cleaner by separating lookup/create.
Notifications city-filter only applies when broadcast meta has 'city'; current admin_announce only sets meta.city when provided — looks correct.
MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} throughout — good.
All endpoints use Pydantic models for input validation — good.
JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL, CLOUDINARY_* read from environment with no hardcoded defaults — good (fails fast).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; profile-setup submit requires age_group tap — working as designed)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed_data() auto-creates admin (9999999999), 5 sample members, 3 campaigns, 3 issues, 1 welcome announcement on startup. Verified present. Tests also created TEST_अभियान campaign, TEST_समस्या issue, TEST_घोषणा announcement, a TEST member (mobile starts with 95...), and a TEST flag.

Frontend uses Expo Router file-based routing; bottom tabs live under /(tabs)/, admin under /admin, auth under /auth/. All major interactive elements have testID. Mock OTP is 123456 for ALL mobiles.
